title: 9 Science KCPE 2010
text:
KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL
 KCPE 2010
 SCIENCE
 READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY
 Time:1 hour 40 minutes
 1. You have been given this question booklet and a separate answer sheet. The question booklet
 contains 50 question
 2. Do any necessary rough work in this booklet.
 3. When you have chosen your answer, mark it on the ANSWER SHEET, not in this question
 booklet.
 4. Use only an ordinary pencil.
 5. Make sure that you have written on the answer sheet:
 YOUR INDEX NUMBER
 YOUR NAME
 NAME OF YOUR SHOOL
 6. By drawing a dark line inside the correct numbered boxes mark your full Index Number(i.e
 School code number and the three-figured Candidate’s number)in the grid near the top of the
 answer sheet.
 7. Do not make any marks outside the boxes.
 8. Keep the sheet as clean as possible and do not fold it.
 9. For each of the question 1-50 four answers are given. The answers are lettered A,B,C and D. In
 each case only ONE of the four answers is correct. Choose the correct answer.
 10. On the answer sheet the correct answer is to be shown by drawing a dark line inside the box in
 which the letter have chosen is written.
 Example
 In the Question booklet.
 4. Which one of the following components of blood is involved in the clotting after injury?
 A. Plasma
 B. White blood cells
 C. Red blood cells
 D. Platelets
 The correct answer is D
 1 [A] [B] [C] [D] 14. [A] [B] [C] [D] 24. [A] [B] [C] [D] 34. [A] [B] [C] [D]
 11. Your dark line MUST be within the box.
 12. For each question ONLY ONE box is to be marked in each set of four boxes.
 This question paper consists of 7 printed pages and 1 black page.
 The Kenya National Examination Council, 2010.
 1. Which one of the following pests attack seedlings?
 A. Stalk borers.
 B. Aphids.
 C. Cut worms.
 D. Weaverbirds.
 2. Which one of the following pairs of vessels is correctly matched with the type of blood
 they carry?
 Oxygenated blood deoxygenated blood
 A. Aorta pulmonary artery.
 B. Venacava pulmonary vein.
 C. Pulmonary artery venacava.
 D. Aorta pulmonary vein.
 3. Which one of the following pairs of parasites attack both poultry and rabbit?
 A. Mites and lice.
 B. Lice and fleas.
 C. Mites and fleas.
 D. Ticks and mites.
 4. Which one following statements about beans seeds is NOT CORRECT?
 A. The radicle develops into shoot and plumule into roots.
 B. The micropyle allows air and water to enter seed.
 C. The hilum is a scar where the seed was attached to the fruit wall.
 D. The radicle emerges from the seed before the plumule during germination.
 5. The following are some characteristics of a flower:
 i) Small size.
 ii) Scented.
 iii) Long feathery stigma.
 iv) Produce fewer and large sticky pollen grain.
 Which one of the following pairs of characteristics is for a wind pollinated flower?
 A. (i) and (iv).
 B. (ii) and (iv).
 C. (ii) and (iii).
 D. (i) and (iii).

 conductor of electricity.
 DIAGRAM
 Which one of the following materials when used to connect wires at position K would

 A. Piece of thread.
 B. Razor and blade.

 D. Cello tape.

 for seed germination.
 Germination occurred in_________.
 A. Q, S and T.
 B. P and Q.
 C. R and T.
 D. R and S.
 8. Which one of the following is an adaptation of plants in wet areas?
 A. Freshy leaves.
 B. Fewer leaves.
 C. Thick barks.
 D. Broad leaves.

 In the diagram the layer of ash is represented by
 A. K.
 B. L.

 D. N.

 A. The sock is made up of strong polythene sheet.
 B. End Q is larger than end P.
 C. A strong wire was used to make end P.

 11. Which one of the following pairs consists only of materials that would not sink in water
 even when their shape is changed?
 A. Wax and wood
 B. Wood and aluminum
 C. Aluminum and glass
 D. Glass and wax

 The process investigate is
 Evaporation
 14. Which one of the following pair of diseases are infants immunized against at the 9 th
 month?
 A. Tuberculosis and polio
 B. Tetanus and whooping cough
 C. Hepatitis B and diphtheria
 D. Measles and yellow fever
 15. The chart below represents a weather record for five days
 Which one of the following statement is true about the weather chart?
 A. Sunny in the morning it was windy in the afternoon
 B. Cloudy in the morning, it was sunny in the afternoon
 C. Calm in the morning, it was sunny in the afternoon
 D. Windy in the morning, it rained in the afternoon
 16. Which one of the following statement is true about some levers when in use?
 A. In crowbar, the load is between the effort and fulcrum
 B. In a crowbar the effort is between the load and fulcrum
 C. In a wheelbarrow, the fulcrum is between the load and the effort
 D. In a spade, the effort is between the load and fulcrum
 17. Which one of the following statements is not true about HIV/AIDS may spread by
 A. Sharing of unstererlised razor blades
 B. Coming into conduct with other people body fluids
 C. Shaking hands and hugging infected persons
 D. Transfusing unscreened blood
 18. Which one of the following planets are in the fifth and seventh position from the sun
 respectively
 A. Mars and Saturn
 B. Jupiter and Uranus
 C. Jupiter and Saturn
 D. Mars and Uranus
 19. In the human body water is absorbed in the
 A. Large intestine
 B. Small intestine
 C. Stomach
 D. Rectum
 20. Which one of the following pairs consists only substances that are in the same state of
 matter?
 A. Oil and water vapour
 B. Wax and glue
 C. Ice and water
 D. Air and water vapour

 diagram below
 From the results the soil samples X, Y and Z are most likely to be
 X Y Z

 D. Sand loam clay
 22. In an experiment to investigate a certain component of soil, water was added to garden
 soil in the glass container. The component of soil investigated was
 A. Air
 B. Mineral particles
 C. Living organism
 D. Organic matter
 23. Tapeworm in livestock are fund in the
 A. Large intestine
 B. Stomach
 C. Lungs
 D. Small intestine
 24. Which one of the following mixtures can be separated by winnowing?
 A. Flour and husks
 B. Maize and millet
 C. Rice and sand
 D. Millet and husks
 25. Which one of the following groups of sources of energy consists of only sources that
 have chemical energy?
 A. Charcoal, kerosene, food
 B. Dynamo, drycell, firewood
 C. Biogas, hydroelectric power generator ,matches
 D. Geothermal, generator ,cooking gas, car battery
 26. Which one of the following groups of sources of energy consists of inclined planes only?
 A. Ladder, spade, crowbar
 B. Staircase, ladder, a road winding up a hill
 C. Spade, staircase, ladder
 D. A road winding up a hill, craw hammer, crowbar
 B. Freezing
 C. Condensation
 D. Convection

 A. A wind mill to pump water
 B. Biogas for cooking
 C. Solar panel to produce electricity
 D. A traditional jiko for cooking

 A. Typhoid
 B. Bilhazia
 C. Malaria
 D. Cholera
 30. Which one of the following pairs of birds have beaks adapted to the same type of feeding
 A. Chicken and duck
 B. Sunbird and chicken
 C. Eagle and hawk
 D. Hawk and duck
 31. Which one of the following methods of preserving food is both modern and traditional?
 A. Salting
 B. Using honey
 C. Smoking
 D. Drying
 32. Which one of the following deficiency diseases is caused by lack of calcium in the diet?
 A. Anaemia
 B. Kwashiorkor
 C. Rickets
 D. Marasmas
 33. Which one of the following statements is not true about commercial feeds animals
 A. They are given mainly for protection against diseases
 B. Some are given as the only feed
 C. They mainly to increase production
 D. Some are given together with other feed
 34. Which one of the following pairs of components of the environment do all animals
 depend on directly
 A. Soil and plants
 B. Air and water
 C. Soil and air
 D. Minerals salts and water
 35. Which one of the following foods id correctly matched to its group?
 Food food group
 A. Groundnuts energy giving
 B. Eggs protective
 C. Carrots energy giving
 D. Bananas body building
 36. Which one of the following animals feeds provides diet of proteins and carbohydrates?
 A. Clover and Lucerne
 B. Sunflower seeds and barley
 C. Sunflower seeds and maize grain
 D. Lucerne and maize grain
 37. The diagram below represents a person pushing a heavy log of wood along a flat surface
 Which one of the following changes would make the person push the log more easly?
 A. Smearing oil on the flat surface
 B. Wearing shoes with rough sole
 C. Smearing oil on the log of wood
 D. Placing rollers on the flat surface
 38. The following are some liquids
 i) Water
 ii) Kerosene
 iii) Fresh milk
 iv) Cooking oil
 Which two liquids will mix when put in the container
 A. (i) and (iv)
 B. (ii) and (iii)
 C. ?(iii) and (iv)
 D. (ii) and (iv)
 39. Which one of the following groups consists of materials that are All magnetic?
 A. Staple pins, scissors, metallic bottle top
 B. Silver coin, knife, marble balls
 C. Ball bearing, copper coin, razor blade
 D. Hack saw, steel wool, aluminium
 40. Which one of the following practices pollutes soil, air and water?
 A. Use of all farm chemical
 B. Burning of tyres and plastic
 C. Dumping of industrials waste
 D. Use of artificial fertilizers
 41. If medicine remains after taking prescribed dose,it is advisable to?
 A. Keep and use it later
 B. Disposes of the medicine
 C. Continue taking until it is fished
 D. Gives it to someone with the same sickness
 42. Which one of the following os most likely to cause damage to corrugated iron sheets
 A. Aerosol
 B. Burning farm waste
 C. sewage

 A. Typhoid
 B. Bilhazias
 C. Cholera

 47. Which one of the following is a reason why a glass container is likely to break if hot
 water is poured into it?
 A. Sudden expansion of the inner side of the glass wall
 B. Sudden expansion of air in the container
 C. Sudden contraction of the outer side of the glass wall
 D. The fact that the heat wall had expand
 48. On sea-saw a small boy lift a big boy when
 A. The small boy stands on it
 B. The two boys interchange position
 C. The two boys moves closer to the fulcrum
 D. The two boys move equal distance away from the fulcrum
 49. The following are steps followed when investigating the force required to lift a load using
 fixed pulley but not in their order?
 i) Tie the load with a string
 ii) Pass the string with the pulley on the support
 iii) Pull the spring balance and measure
 iv) Fix the pulley on the support
 v) Tie the spring balance at the end of spring
 The correct order of steps to be followed is
 A. (ii) (i) (iv) (v) (iii)
 B. (i) (ii) (iv) (v) (iii)
 C. (v) (i) (ii) (iv) (iii)
 D. (iv) )i) (ii) (v) (iii)
